QuestInfo.name: Chris's Request
QuestInfo.1:
You got another request from Nella. Chris's pillow was stolen a few days ago and now he can't sleep. To make a new pillow, he needs #b10 pieces of Leather#k. You should get them as soon as possible, so Chris can get some sleep!


#i4000021# #t4000021# #b#c4000021##k/10
QuestInfo.2: You delivered what Chris asked for and got some refined steal and bronze. Chris can finally sleep well in his new pillow. Return to Nella for another gig.

0.0: Oh, thanks for coming! I just got a new request for you. It seems like #b#p1052003##k from the hardware store is having trouble sleeping these days. Someone apparently stole his pillow... Now who in their right mind would steal a pillow? Geez.
0.1: In any case, we need to make a new pillow, but it's not that easy to get the required materials. Can you get #b10 pieces of #t4000021##k? That shouldn't be too difficult. Come see me after you have collected everything.

1.0: Great work. It is a pleasure working with you, you know that? Alright, let's talk rewards. #b#p1052003##k is giving you #b1 #t4011001##k and #b1 #t4011000##k.

yes.0: Alright, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.

item.0: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that #b#p1052003##k requested. You need #b10 pieces #t4000021##k in order to create a new pillow. Just bring everything to me. Good luck!
